metadata.name: Global Marine Sediment‑Core Geochemistry Dataset
metadata.description: A worldwide collection of 3,754 marine sediment‑core observations with latitude −46.5797° to +87.89° and longitude −178.1665° to +174.3141°. Each record includes geochemical and isotopic measurements such as δ34S, age (Ma), CaCO₃, TOC, CH₄, sediment rate, lithology, elevation and distance to shore. Sampling dates are available for 1,035 rows, spanning 1974‑07‑18 to 2016‑07‑04.
metadata.temporal: irregular timestamps (sub‑second granularity where present; 1,035 of 3,754 rows have valid dates)
